name: @infinityrx/portal-shared
description: Shared codebase for InfinityRx portal apps. Source-mode TypeScript package consumed by Next.js apps via `transpilePackages` in next.config.ts. Multi-app-ready: future portal apps (member, manufacturer) consume this same package via npm workspace symlink. See README.md for the source-mode pattern.
_comment_exports: Subpath patterns include the .ts extension on the target side because consumers import without an extension (e.g. `@infinityrx/portal-shared/hooks/use-sse`). The wildcard captures the basename and the target reconstructs with .ts so TypeScript moduleResolution=bundler can resolve to a real file. Turbopack and webpack both honor this pattern.
